questions.q: What was unusual about Emperor Trojan?
o: He had a beard down to the ground
questions.e: “U toga cara bile su uši kozje.”

questions.q: What did the emperor do to barbers who saw his ears?
questions.e: A barber who said he saw goat's ears was beheaded at once.

questions.q: What did the apprentice answer when the emperor asked what he had seen?
o: That the emperor needed a haircut
That he was afraid to answer
That he had seen goat's ears
questions.e: The apprentice said he had seen nothing.

questions.q: Why did the apprentice begin to waste away?
o: He was tormented that he could not tell anyone the secret
questions.e: The secret tormented him because he could not tell anyone, so he wasted away.

questions.q: What did the apprentice do to feel better?
o: Wrote a letter to the emperor
Dug a hole in a field and told the secret to the earth
questions.e: He dug a hole, put his head in and told the earth three times.

questions.q: What grew in that place, and what happened to the pipes?
o: An elder tree grew, and every pipe sang “The emperor Trojan has goat's ears!”
A birch grew and was made into a staff
An apple tree with golden apples grew
questions.e: An elder tree grew from the hole, and every pipe made from it sang the secret.

o: The emperor realised nothing can be hidden and spared the apprentice
questions.e: The emperor saw that nothing on earth can be hidden and spared the barber's life.
